Economy · India

Indian stock market declines amid rising crude oil prices

India's BSE Sensex fell 278 points to 77,450 and the NSE Nifty50 dropped 57 points to 24,230 in early trade. This decline occurred as crude oil prices surged past $90 per barrel. Global markets also experienced a downturn, with Euro zone bond yields nearing 15-year highs and US stocks edging back from records due to Middle East conflict concerns and rising oil prices.
